sections.name: fetchJSON
sections.title: Shared fetch helper
sections.what: Asks the server for data at a given address and returns the result, or raises an error when the reply is not successful.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. It keeps error handling in one place for these queries.
sections.watch_out: Plain fetch does not carry the same settings as the main request wrapper, so behavior can differ.

sections.name: projectDetailQuery
sections.title: Named data queries
sections.what: Defines the projects list, a single project's detail, site statistics, and the glossary as reusable query recipes.
sections.why: Gives each screen a fixed label and address for its data.
sections.watch_out: The projects list and detail queries return untyped data, so a wrong field name will not be caught.

summary: A small, older set of data request helpers, kept under a name that says disabled.
purpose: Unclear from the code. The name suggests it is set aside and not used.
why: Likely reason: it was replaced by the main API file, and was kept without being deleted. The code does not say.
how: A shared helper calls the server, throws an error if the reply is not successful, and returns the parsed data. Four named queries use that helper for projects, one project's details, site statistics, and the glossary.
inputs: Web addresses for the project, statistics, and glossary endpoints.
outputs: Query definitions that screens can use to fetch data.
risks: The helper sends plain requests and does not use the shared request wrapper, so it may miss settings that wrapper applies. Results are not checked for shape.
debug: Search the project for imports of this file. If none exist, it is safe to ignore. If a screen fails, compare it with the main API file.
